concept: A clumsy but lovable raccoon named Rocky tries to steal food from a campsite, but his antics cause chaos and hilarity.
hook: Rocky's eyes light up at the sight of a picnic basket

shot1.description: Rocky sniffs around the campsite, finding nothing but trash

shot2.description: Rocky spots the picnic basket and his eyes widen with excitement

shot3.description: Rocky's paws grasp for the basket

shot4.description: Rocky tries to open the basket, but it's too tightly sealed

shot5.description: Rocky uses his paws to try and pry the lid open, with comical results

shot6.description: Rocky grabs a nearby stick and starts poking at the basket, causing it to roll away

shot7.description: Rocky's face falls as he realizes his plans have backfired

shot8.description: The campers return, laughing at the chaos Rocky has caused
